snippet.title: BARREL ROLL RELEASE
snippet.description:
🤠 Barrel Roll is available now on Steam ! 🥳
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860590/Barrel_Roll/

Barrel Roll is a roguelike deckbuilder, turn based, taking place in a futuristic far west. The deck ? A 6 slot revolver barrel. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as many criminals as you can.

It’s been a long journey since the beginning of this project, if you want to know more or give us feedbacks come on our discord with all the other Barrel Rollers: https://discord.gg/r3baD26qrf

For every person who will take the time to spread the word, buy the game, make feedback, join the community or support us in general… Thank you from all Barrel Roll’s team you give meaning 

#roguelike 
#deckbuilder 
#indiegames
